**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-9938027)

Loss-of-function mutations in TNFRSF13C (causing immunodeficiency 131) and IRF4 (contributing to MONDO:0013284) both impair the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Dysregulation of this central immune signaling pathway leads to cellular immunodeficiency and recurrent respiratory infections in both conditions.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that mutations in TNFRSF13C and IRF4 affect entirely distinct and non-overlapping downstream signaling pathways or cellular processes, with no shared impact on NF-kappaB signaling or immune cell function. _(variant: Absence of pathogenic variants in gnomAD for the specific causal mutations identified in each disease, suggesting their rarity and specific pathogenicity.)_
